description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and serializers related to exceptions and message serialization in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes grain interfaces for exception handling and message serialization, as well as codecs for unserializable and undeserializable types.

classes.name: UndeserializableType
classes.description: A struct representing a type that cannot be deserialized, containing a constant failure message and a numerical identifier.

classes.name: UnserializableType
classes.description: A placeholder class representing a type that is unserializable.

classes.name: UndeserializableTypeCodec
classes.description: A serializer and copier for UndeserializableType, which throws exceptions during deserialization.

classes.name: UnserializableTypeCodec
classes.description: A serializer and copier for UnserializableType, with methods that throw exceptions when writing.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the input UndeserializableType or UnserializableType.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Attempts to read/from a reader to produce an UndeserializableType, but throws NotSupportedException.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes the field data for either UndeserializableType or UnserializableType; may throw NotSupportedException.
